title: Eastern Massachusetts highway network
description: Earthquake accessibility to either airport node n22 or n66.

source.origin: network-datasets, via the forward pilot's package ema-highway (experiments/forward-bn-pilot/packages/ema-highway/network.json at commit 784e6cc)
source.note: This file is now the source; the package it was generated from was removed.

assumptions.bridge_representation: Each network edge or arc is represented by one highway bridge.
assumptions.bridge_class: Use each edge's fragility_type; use HWB11 only if absent.
assumptions.coordinates: x/y are schematic planar units that the reference scenario reads as kilometres; georeferencing shows one unit is about 1.81 real km. lat/lon are fitted to town centres (about +/-7 km) and are what a ShakeMap is read at, at arc midpoints.
assumptions.dependence: Bridge states are sampled independently conditional on the hazard scenario.
assumptions.functionality: Moved out of the data: the usable-from-damage parameter set the assembly binds (policy.closed-at-extensive) states it.
assumptions.capacity: 1 per link, assumed: the dataset gives no capacities, so max flow counts link-disjoint routes.
assumptions.event: Epicentre from the pilot's schematic (x=1.0, y=10.0) by an affine fit of node x/y to lat/lon; depth 10 km assumed. Distances are now real kilometres, so shaking is lower than the pilot's, which read schematic units as km.
assumptions.bridge_location: Each bridge sits at the midpoint of its link's end nodes; bridge locations are not surveyed.
